We construct four self-adjoint inputs with two coordinates in M_2(C) for which the literal exponential-defined Novak kernel is Hermitian but not positive semidefinite. An explicit quadratic form equals cos(pisqrt(15))-3 and is at most -2. This refutes Krishna's C-algebraic extension; the scalar and commutative Novak theorems are unaffected.
